# task-3c961022: overlap across a divider

A uniform straight divider (vertical or horizontal) separates two equal-size panels. Exclude the divider, compare corresponding coordinates between the panels, and write color 2 iff both corresponding cells are non-background; otherwise write 0. Output dimensions match one panel.
